definitions.gloss: morning person; early riser type; morning-oriented
definitions.explanation: A person or lifestyle pattern characterized by waking up early and being most productive in the morning hours.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{朝型|あさがた}の{人間|にんげん}だ。
{受験|じゅけん}{勉強|べんきょう}のために{朝型|あさがた}の{生活|せいかつ}に{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I switched to a morning-oriented lifestyle for exam preparation.

examples.japanese: {朝型|あさがた}に{変|か}えてから、{仕事|しごと}の{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Since switching to a morning schedule, my work efficiency has improved.

notes:
{朝型|あさがた} describes a morning-oriented person or lifestyle — someone who wakes early and is most active in the morning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝型|あさがた}の{生活|せいかつ}: morning-oriented lifestyle
- {朝型|あさがた}の{人間|にんげん}: a morning person
- {朝型|あさがた}に{変|か}える/{切|き}り{替|か}える: to switch to a morning schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜型|よるがた}: night-owl type (antonym)
- {朝型|あさがた} vs. {夜型|よるがた} is a common topic in lifestyle, health, and productivity discussions in Japan.

FORMS:
{朝|あさ} (morning) + {型|がた} (type/pattern). The suffix 〜{型|がた} is productive: {夜型|よるがた}, A{型|がた} (blood type A), etc.
